# Tagwise Identity Protocol — Documentation

> Comprehensive developer documentation for the Tagwise Identity Protocol (TIP), the identity layer for Solana payments.

This is the documentation site for the Tagwise Identity Protocol. For the main website, see [tagwise.me](https://tagwise.me) or its [llms.txt](https://tagwise.me/llms.txt).

## Getting Started

- [Documentation Home](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs): Introduction and overview
- [Quickstart](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/quickstart): Install the SDK and resolve your first @tag in minutes

## Concepts

- [Architecture](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/concepts/architecture): System architecture — on-chain program, API layer, SDK
- [Source of Truth](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/concepts/source-of-truth): Solana blockchain as the authoritative identity store
- [PDAs and Accounts](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/concepts/pdas-and-accounts): Program Derived Addresses for identity data
- [Tag Rules and Moderation](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/concepts/tag-rules-and-moderation): Tag validation and moderation policies
- [Security and Auth](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/concepts/security-and-auth): Wallet-based challenge–response authentication

## Integration Guides

- [Registering a Tag](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/integration-guides/registering-a-tag): Register new @tags
- [Managing Profiles and Wallets](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/integration-guides/managing-profiles-and-wallets): Update identity profiles
- [Wallet Authentication](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/integration-guides/wallet-authentication): Implement wallet auth
- [Direct On-Chain Resolution](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/integration-guides/direct-on-chain-resolution): Resolve tags from Solana directly
- [Payment Links and QR](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/integration-guides/payment-links-and-qr): Generate payment links and QR codes

## SDK Reference

The SDK is published as `@tagwise/tip-sdk` on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tagwise/tip-sdk).

- [TipClient](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/sdk-reference/tip-client): Main client class
- [On-Chain Resolution](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/sdk-reference/on-chain-resolution): Blockchain resolution functions
- [Tag Utilities](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/sdk-reference/tag-utilities): Validation and formatting helpers
- [Types and Models](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/sdk-reference/types-and-models): TypeScript types
- [Errors and Exceptions](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/sdk-reference/errors-and-exceptions): Error handling

## API Reference

- [Resolve Tag](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/TagsController_resolve): Resolve @tag → wallet address
- [Get Identity](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/TagsController_identity): Full identity profile
- [Check Availability](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/TagsController_availability): Tag availability check
- [Search Tags](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/TagsController_search): Search by query
- [Generate QR](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/TagsController_qr): QR code generation
- [Payment Link](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/TagsController_paymentLink): Payment link generation
- [Update Identity](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/TagsController_updateIdentity): Update profile (auth required)
- [Update Wallet](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/TagsController_updateWallet): Update wallet (auth required)
- [Register](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/RegisterController_register): Register a new tag
- [Auth Challenge](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/AuthController_challenge): Request auth challenge
- [Auth Verify](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/AuthController_verify): Verify signed challenge
- [Auth Me](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/AuthController_me): Current authenticated user
- [Health Check](https://docs.tagwise.me/docs/api-reference/HealthController_check): API health
